data.source_title: Improving Operating Room Turnover in Robotic Surgery: A Human Factors Approach
data.locator: Abstract; task-time breakdown of 20 observed pre-intervention turnovers
data.source_setting: Robotic-surgery operating rooms at one tertiary hospital; United States (city not stated in accessible abstract).
data.source_period: Pre-intervention observations Jan–Apr 2018; post-intervention observations Jan–Jun 2019.
data.source_n: 40 observed robotic turnovers: 20 pre-intervention and 20 post-intervention.
data.source_evidence_basis: Direct observation of 20 pre-intervention turnovers; abstract reports mean task time.
data.limitations: Robotic cases at one tertiary hospital; small sample and workflow-specific. Abstract does not report SD/range for these task values. Retrieval time is not general interfacility patient transport.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Treat as an external task-level scenario range anchor for resource-constrained OR sequencing; do not transplant robotic workflow durations as local averages.
